notes.title: New Game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to share good news with you!

A new game based on the CASE: Animatronics universe is coming out tomorrow!
You can check out the game at the link:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826400/CASE_RECORDS_Fear_of_Abduction/]CASE RECORDS: FEAR OF ABDUCTION[/url]

We recently published a new trailer on YouTube and on the game page itself.
We hope for your support and interest in the new project.

We are sure that horror game fans will like our new game :)

notes.content:

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25579315/bd82cb6d981ce822f4d5db17929f0cc17d6808bf.jpg[/img]
- Added spanish language
- Added “start new game” button in harcore mode
- Added an ability to skip dialogues
- Added new checkpoints in normal mode
- Flashlight is now working correctly
- Fixed the bug where the AI sometimes gets stuck
- Animatronics pursuit behavior is now vastly improved
- Animatronics do not kill you through the wall from now on
- Animatronics no longer check the closets and tables so often
